usageNotes: Returns the available sub-resource directories for a specific SDN zone as seen from a given node — effectively a navigation index rather than zone configuration detail. Use this to discover what sub-endpoints (e.g. 'content') are available under a zone before drilling deeper. Requires SDN.Audit on the zone path; the target node must be online.

examples.summary: List sub-resource directories for SDN zone 'vlan10' on node 'pve1'

tips: Zone names are 2–8 characters, must start with a letter, and contain only alphanumerics — no hyphens or underscores.
The response is a directory index (array of subdir strings), not zone configuration; use the cluster-level SDN zone endpoints to read or modify zone settings.
Call this first to know which child endpoints exist before making follow-up requests against a zone on a specific node.
